messages.subject: Testing assumptions moderated mediation SEM lavaan
parts:
Hi all,

For my thesis I developed a mediation and a moderated mediation with SEM usign the lavaan package. I need to test assumptions but I can't get any guidelines on how to do it. I know I can get the residuals with resid() but when i try to run for example qqnorm(residuals) it doesn't work. 
Could someone help me?

C.

messages.author: 3fe90052fbf2f899
messages.subject: Re: Testing assumptions moderated mediation SEM lavaan
parts: I know I can get the residuals with resid()
Those are covariance residuals: differences between the observed and expected covariance matrix (not observed and expected casewise data points).
when i try to run for example qqnorm(residuals) it doesn't work.

Are you sure that is what you want?  Usually there aren't that many unique elements of an analyzed covariance matrix, so it might not make much sense to try inferring something about the distribution of covariance residuals.
